      required:

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'); just the lastName when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Assigned member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', unifying the
                former customerCode and membershipNumber. REGION is the region code derived from the
                postcode, FY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName,
                and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>.
                A colliding id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>' with the smallest n of 2 or more
                that makes it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273F1A9C2B4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-December date belongs to the fiscal year ending in
                the following calendar year, numbered by that ending year (e.g. 1 July 2026 is FY27).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode shares it automatically (no opt-in required).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived from the stored fields. Starts at
                0 and adds 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household
                of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from
                registrationDate to today) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's
                registration day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), signalling it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise
                false. The city is compared case-insensitively.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (a
                subdomain of, or shares the second-level label with, a known disposable email
                domain), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity (already holds 40 or more
                owners, the point at which the capacity warning begins); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 inclusive, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored fields.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', where normalizedTelephone
                is the E.164 telephone, the email component is the lower-cased email or empty, and
                householdId is the deterministic identifier for the owner's household (derived from
                the last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not rejected as a household duplicate, was
                created sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is
                never flagged. Computed once at creation, then stored and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the id of the existing owner whose
                lastName and postcode this owner shares; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: Canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/7'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /owners/{id} sets it true while retaining the record. Deleted owners
                are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted

# Owner Identity / Identifier-Derivation / Versioning — Findings

All identity logic lives under `src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/` and `.../util/`, is surfaced through `OwnerMapper`, described in `openapi.yml`, and targeted by the acceptance tests. Note: the DTO classes (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`) are code-generated from `openapi.yml` at build time — there are no `OwnerDto.java`/`OwnerFieldsDto.java` source files in the tree.

## 1. Region-code derivation and how it is mixed into identifiers

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/LocalityResolver.java`**
The central region engine. Fixed tables: `CITY_REGION` (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), `REGION_RANGE` (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (NSW→Australia/Sydney, etc.). Key methods:
- `localityOf(String city)` and `localityOf(String postcode, String city)` — postcode range wins, else city table, else `UNKNOWN`.
- `regionOfMemberId(String memberId)` — reads the REGION back off a memberId by taking the leading run of letters (this is how `locality`/`timezone`/`ownerSegment` are derived in the mapper, NOT from postcode/city directly).
- `isKnownRegion(String region)`, `timezoneOfRegion(String region)`, private `regionForPostcode`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMemberId.java`**
Mixes the region into the `memberId`. Format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (e.g. `NSW273F1A9C2B4`):
- `region = LocalityResolver.localityOf(owner.getPostcode(), owner.getCity())`
- `fy = FiscalYear.yearOf(registrationDate) % 100` zero-padded
- `hash8 = Sha256Hash.upperHex(owner.getTelephone() + owner.getLastName(), 8)` (`HASH_LENGTH = 8`)
- `baseId = region + fy + hash8 + CheckDigit.luhnOf(body)`; collisions de-duped by appending `-<n>` (n≥2). Comment states it "unifies the former `customerCode` and `membershipNumber`".

## 2. householdId, identityKey, memberId production

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Household.java`**
`householdId` = first 12 UPPER-hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`. `idFor(OwnerFieldsDto)`, `idFor(Owner)`, `sharesHousehold(...)`, `memberCount(...)`, private `deriveId`/`normalizeName`/`normalizePostcode`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`**
`service(@Val Owner)` → `owner.setHouseholdId(Household.idFor(owner))`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentityKey.java`**
`identityKey` = lower-case hex SHA-256 of `normalizedTelephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + soundex(lastName)`. `forRequest(OwnerFieldsDto)`, `forOwner(Owner)`, private `build`/`sha256hex`/`normalizeTelephone`/`normalizeEmail`.

**`AssignMemberId.java`** (above) — produces `memberId`.

Supporting helpers:
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256Hash.java`** — `upperHex(String s, int n)`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CheckDigit.java`** — `luhnOf(String)`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Soundex.java`** — `soundex(String name)` (S530-style), used by identityKey and possible-duplicate matching.

## 3. Owner model fields

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`**
Persisted identity columns: `member_id` (`memberId`), `household_id` (`householdId`), `postcode`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, `registrationDate`, `namesake_count`, `possible_duplicate`, `possible_duplicate_of`, `deleted`. No `locality`/`timezone`/`ownerSegment`/`identityKey` columns — those are derived at mapping time.

## 4. User-facing locality / timezone + owner response DTO shape

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`**
`toOwnerDto(Owner)` derives the read-only response fields via `@Mapping` expressions:
- `locality` → `LocalityResolver.regionOfMemberId(owner.getMemberId())`
- `timezone` → `LocalityResolver.timezoneOfRegion(LocalityResolver.regionOfMemberId(owner.getMemberId()))`
- `ownerSegment` → `OwnerSegment.of(membershipLevel, regionOfMemberId(memberId))`
- `identityKey` → `OwnerIdentityKey.forOwner(owner)`
- plus `salutation`, `displayName`, `initials`, `telephoneDisplay`, `membershipPoints/Level`, `fiscalYear`, `contactPreference`, `ageBand`, `selfLink`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java`**
Builds the response: maps to `OwnerDto` then sets `bulkSignupWarning`, `capacityWarning`, `riskFlag`, `membershipPoints`, `membershipLevel`. Related: `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`, `RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java` (same directory). The current response shape is FLAT (memberId/identityKey/householdId at top level; no `apiVersion`).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — schema for the owner response. Relevant field descriptions: `memberId` (2152), `householdId` (2174), `locality` (2214), `timezone` (2221), `ownerSegment` (2229), `identityKey` (2278), `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` (2288/2297). ## 5. Owner segment / derived region

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/OwnerSegment.java`**
`of(int membershipLevel, String locality)` → `"<TIER>_<AREA>"`; `PREMIUM_LEVEL = 3`; TIER PREMIUM/STANDARD, AREA METRO (known region) / REGIONAL.

## 6. Audit event with (implied) schema version

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`**
Emits to the `AUDIT` logger: a human-readable line (`owner created id=… memberId=… registrationDate=… membershipLevel=…`) plus `OwnerCreatedEvent.of(owner, level).toJson()`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`**
Immutable structured event. JSON `{seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, event}`; `EVENT = "OWNER_CREATED"`; process-wide `AtomicLong SEQUENCE`; `primaryIdentifierOf(owner)` returns `owner.getMemberId()`. **There is no explicit `schemaVersion`/`apiVersion` field in this event today** — the closest concept is the `event` discriminator and `seq`.

## 7. "V1/V2/version" in the identity context

- **No `apiVersion`, nested `identity` object, or `schemaVersion` exists in the current main-source implementation** (confirmed by grep across `src/main` and `build`). The response is flat and version-less.
- The only "version" surfaces are: `openapi.yml` `info.version: '1.0'`, the "Version 2 endpoints" tag text, and the per-response `ETag` "version of the response" header.

## Tests (identity, householdId, identityKey, memberId, locality, audit, segment, apiVersion, schemaVersion)

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`**
Single test `coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions()` — this is the **identity-v2 target contract** and does NOT match current output. It asserts:
- `$.apiVersion == 2`
- `$.identity.memberId`, `$.identity.identityKey`, `$.identity.householdId` all non-empty (nested under an `identity` object)
- top-level `$.memberId`, `$.identityKey`, `$.householdId` do NOT exist.
Comment: "apiVersion is 2, the memberId/identityKey/householdId are grouped under a nested 'identity' object … Exact structural contract."

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`**
Black-box harness for `POST /api/owners` + `GET /api/owners/{id}`. Provides `structuredOwner()`, `knownOwner(city)`, pinned reference tables `CITY_REGION`, `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES`, `HOLIDAYS`, helpers `region(city)`, `timezone(city)`, `validPostcode(city)`, `toBusinessDay(...)`, and identity-algorithm replicas `sha256hex`, `shaHex(s,n)`, `luhn(s)`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`**
Test utility capturing the `AUDIT` logback logger (`messages()`, `anyContains(...)`, `anyAtLevel(level, ...)`, `count()`) for asserting `OwnerCreatedEvent` / audit lines.

## Key cross-cutting observation
The acceptance test defines a **V2 identity shape** (`apiVersion: 2`, nested `identity{memberId, identityKey, householdId}`) that is not yet implemented — current code (`OwnerMapper`, `RespondWithOwner`, `openapi.yml`) produces a flat, unversioned response. Additionally, `openapi.yml`'s `identityKey` description is stale relative to `OwnerIdentityKey.java` (plaintext-householdId vs hashed-soundex).

===== OwnerFields schema (1991-2110) =====
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific for the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility, but when the structured fields are supplied it is composed
            from them and returned as the normalized 'addressLine1' with, when present, a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). Normalized like 'address' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postal code. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server defaults it to the current date. The
            effective date (supplied or defaulted) must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or
            Sunday is rolled forward to the following Monday before it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; when
            present it is stored and returned, and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only hint. When true, permits creating this owner even when
            another owner already exists in the same household (same last name and postcode);
            such an owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. When false (the default) a second owner in an existing household
            is rejected with 409. Does not affect the assigned householdId, which is derived
            purely from the last name and postcode. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific for the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility, but when the structured fields are supplied it is composed
            from them and returned as the normalized 'addressLine1' with, when present, a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). Normalized like 'address' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postal code. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server defaults it to the current date. The
            effective date (supplied or defaulted) must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or
            Sunday is rolled forward to the following Monday before it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; when
            present it is stored and returned, and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only hint. When true, permits creating this owner even when
            another owner already exists in the same household (same last name and postcode);
            such an owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. When false (the default) a second owner in an existing household
            is rejected with 409. Does not affect the assigned householdId, which is derived
            purely from the last name and postcode. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'); just the lastName when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Assigned member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', unifying the
                former customerCode and membershipNumber. REGION is the region code derived from the
                postcode, FY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName,
                and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>.
                A colliding id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>' with the smallest n of 2 or more
                that makes it unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW273F1A9C2B4'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-December date belongs to the fiscal year ending in
                the following calendar year, numbered by that ending year (e.g. 1 July 2026 is FY27).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode shares it automatically (no opt-in required).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived from the stored fields. Starts at
                0 and adds 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household
                of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from
                registrationDate to today) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's
                registration day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), signalling it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise
                false. The city is compared case-insensitively.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (a
                subdomain of, or shares the second-level label with, a known disposable email
                domain), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity (already holds 40 or more
                owners, the point at which the capacity warning begins); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 inclusive, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored fields.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', where normalizedTelephone
                is the E.164 telephone, the email component is the lower-cased email or empty, and
                householdId is the deterministic identifier for the owner's household (derived from
                the last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not rejected as a household duplicate, was
                created sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is
                never flagged. Computed once at creation, then stored and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the id of the existing owner whose
                lastName and postcode this owner shares; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: Canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/7'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /owners/{id} sets it true while retaining the record. Deleted owners
                are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addPetToOwner
      summary: Adds a pet to an owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The details of the new pet.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Pet or Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwnersPet
      summary: Get a pet by ID
      description: Returns the pet or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
        - name: petId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific for the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility, but when the structured fields are supplied it is composed
            from them and returned as the normalized 'addressLine1' with, when present, a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). Normalized like 'address' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postal code. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server defaults it to the current date. The
            effective date (supplied or defaulted) must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or
            Sunday is rolled forward to the following Monday before it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; when
            present it is stored and returned, and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only hint. When true, permits creating this owner even when
            another owner already exists in the same household (same last name and postcode);
            such an owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. When false (the default) a second owner in an existing household
            is rejected with 409. Does not affect the assigned householdId, which is derived
            purely from the last name and postcode. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'); just the lastName when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract this response conforms to.
                Fixed at 2 for the version-2 identity release, under which the memberId, identityKey
                and householdId are grouped in the nested 'identity' object and each carries the
                fixed 'V2' version tag.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-December date belongs to the fiscal year ending in
                the following calendar year, numbered by that ending year (e.g. 1 July 2026 is FY27).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode shares it automatically (no opt-in required).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived from the stored fields. Starts at
                0 and adds 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household
                of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from
                registrationDate to today) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's
                registration day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), signalling it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise
                false. The city is compared case-insensitively.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (a
                subdomain of, or shares the second-level label with, a known disposable email
                domain), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity (already holds 40 or more
                owners, the point at which the capacity warning begins); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 inclusive, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored fields.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', where normalizedTelephone
                is the E.164 telephone, the email component is the lower-cased email or empty, and
                householdId is the deterministic identifier for the owner's household (derived from
                the last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not rejected as a household duplicate, was
                created sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is
                never flagged. Computed once at creation, then stored and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the id of the existing owner whose
                lastName and postcode this owner shares; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: Canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/7'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /owners/{id} sets it true while retaining the record. Deleted owners
                are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

        size:

        totalElements:

    VetFields:
